sloka: ततः प्रचोदिता भूतैः शंस च अस्मै प्रियाम् इति ।न च सा हि अवदत् सीताम् पृष्टा रामेण शोचता ॥३-६४-८॥
transliteration: tataḥ pracoditā bhūtaiḥ śaṁsa ca asmai priyām iti ।na ca sā hi avadat sītām pṛṣṭā rāmeṇa śocatā ॥3-64-8॥

translations.english: River Godavari (although) prompted by creatures (of Nature) to tell him about his beloved did not respond to brooding Rama.
